data.ruling:
The datasheet verifier's refutation of the functional match holds. The stock verifier confirmed the part, and none of its figures is disputed. Sourcing rule 5 accepts an alternate only if it "works in the same circuit and firmware configuration (registers, I2C address, start-up, surrounding parts)". The re-rank stated that BQ25703ARSNR is a "firmware-identical alternate" to the rank-1 BQ25713. It is not.

The IIN_HOST encoding (register 0Fh) is one step (one LSB, 50 mA) apart between the two parts. BQ25713 codes give I = code x 50 mA. BQ25703A codes carry a 50 mA offset, so I = code x 50 mA + 50 mA. Each data sheet's own electrical table shows this:
- 3000 mA maximum: code 0x3C00 on the BQ25713, 0x3BFF on the BQ25703A.
- 1500 mA maximum: 0x1E00 against 0x1DFF.
- 500 mA maximum: 0x0A00 against 0x09FF.

The Charger input limit requirement (IOBoard.md) asks for a limit that follows the USB-C (Universal Serial Bus Type-C) source's advertisement, so that the source is not overloaded. The rank-1's register values (0x0A/0x1E/0x3C) set a 550 mA, 1550 mA or 3050 mA maximum on the BQ25703A. Each is 50 mA above the advertisement, so the same register configuration overloads the source. Scope: function.

A second difference: watchdog setting 01b is 4 to 7 s on the BQ25713 and 35 to 53 s on the BQ25703A. Both data sheets' register tables still say 5 s.

A shared configuration exists: the 0x09/0x1D/0x3B codes on both parts, or ILIM_HIZ as the limit, with the watchdog at 88 s, 175 s or off. With the 0x3B code the BQ25713's maximum is 2950 mA. Adopting that configuration is a change to the rank-1's configuration. It is a decision for the re-rank or the owner, not a match that holds as the re-rank stated it.

Pins, package, NVDC (narrow voltage DC) power path, BATFET drive and I2C address 6Bh match. The lifecycle status is ACTIVE, the maker is on S1 and the LCSC number is C188229. So the ruling concerns this alternate's fit to this function's rank-1, not the part itself.
data.evidence:
SLUSCU1A (BQ25703A, May 2017, revised May 2018):
- 8.6.6.1: "The register offset is 50 mA. With code 0, the input current limit is 50 mA." Default limit 3.3 A.
- 8.6.6.1.1, Table 29: reset 4100h in the figure, while the heading says 4000h.
- 7.5 IDPM_REG_ACC: 0x3BFF gives 2830 to 3000 mA; 0x1DFF gives 1350 to 1500 mA; 0x09FF gives 340 to 500 mA.
- 7.5 tWDI at [6:5]=01: 35/44/53 s. Table 5 WDTMR_ADJ 01b reads "5 sec".

SLUSD83C (BQ25713/BQ25713B, June 2018, revised May 2023):
- 9.6.6.1: no offset stated. Default limit 3.25 A, reset 4100h.
- IDPM_REG_ACC: 0x3C00 gives 2800/2900/3000 mA; 0x1E00 gives 1300/1400/1500 mA; 0x0A00 gives 300/400/500 mA.
- tWDI at 01: 4/5.5/7 s. At 10: 70/88/105 s. At 11: 140/175/210 s. The BQ25703A has the same figures at 10 and 11.
- Table 9-5 WDTMR_ADJ: the same field and defaults as the BQ25703A.

Both parts: ILIM_HIZ accuracy at 2.2 V is 2800 to 3200 mA.

Requirement: IOBoard.md@e13f5f6, Charger input limit row (500 mA, 900 mA, 1.5 A or 3 A, the source not overloaded). Research.md@e13f5f6, Sourcing rule 5.

Both data sheets were fetched again with vendors.py fetch (chrome, no challenge) into the scratch directory as adj-bq25703a.pdf and adj-bq25713.pdf, and read with pdftotext.
